newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai coffee prices jump as stocks dwindle.
newsitem.headline: Thai coffee prices jump as stocks dwindle.

text.p: Thai robusta coffee prices have jumped to US$1,820 a tonne FAQ/FOB Bangkok compared with around $1,620/$1,650 last week in quiet export trade as available stocks are very limited, traders said on Wednesday.

They said sellers are holding on to remaining depleted stocks, from the 1996/97 season, of only about 2,000 tonnes in the expectation that the recent soaring rally in world coffee prices will resume and suppliers can secure higher levels.
